lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement exhibits vertical alignment in the mid-flank region with approximately 3 to 5 prominent spots per vertical column visible.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands, forming a grid-like pattern. Circular high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersection nodes of these bands throughout the mid-lateral area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the upper edge and shadow-induced lower luminance on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct region of curvilinear, maze-like luminance patterns is visible immediately posterior to the pectoral fin and gill region, transitioning into the standard grid-spot pattern further back on the flank.
